strings: r_c peels the cobwebs away from m_c's face and holds back a wince. The eye is unsalvageable... and the rest of the skin will likely never grow fur again.

m_c can only be glad {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/were/was} able to heal from the devastating burn, though {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can't help but feel angry at {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} now vastly-limited vision.
